rotation: Use up to three unfinished historical source-year/period jobs and three 2026 source-month jobs from /api/backfill and /api/archive, plus two recent/research searches. Prefer unresolved source bodies. Each Monday include research within the eight-query limit. Split capped searches into narrower time windows and log the limits.
sourceRules: Use Firecrawl to search and read actual pages. Do not create records from snippets alone.

Collect historical coverage before 2026 and all 2026 reports through the current source-local date. Recent discovery uses a fourteen-day overlap. Read original dates from article labels or publisher metadata, distinguish publication/update/issue dates, and retain blank dates with a verified publication year in otherDate when no day/month is available. Do not exclude relevant older reports solely because they precede 2026.
For each unseen canonical URL, read source content before writing. Retry a missing body once; log failures.

Retain English and Bangla original titles, attributed paraphrases in both languages, district, river/site, source date with its meaning, material, topics, and source links. Use Unknown for unresolved places and blank dates when unverified.
Keep news, editorials, research, project pages, laws, rules, and lease notices distinct. New entries must be Pending.
Read only accessible content. Flag abstract-only research and partial PDF parsing. Never invent dates, quantities, locations, legality, or unread provisions.
Canonical URL and DOI deduplication is enforced by the writer. Do not merge different events just because they share a river.
Keep new summaries concise and match the source claim strength in both languages. Flag allegations, legal interpretation, dates and OCR for review.

In BOTH English and Bangla summaries, explicitly include the source-stated river/channel/extraction-site name and relevant village/union/upazila/district. For national or unnamed-site coverage retain that scope; never invent a named river. Follow EDITORIAL_POLICY.md.

Include substantive source-stated quantitative details in BOTH summaries: money/fines/lease/revenue/project costs/losses, sand or stone volume/mass, river length, distance, depth, land area, affected people/equipment and duration. Preserve exact amounts, units, ranges, time basis and attribution. Distinguish seized stock from extraction rates, damaged length from project length and mining loss from project cost; keep lakh/crore equivalence across languages. Use extra sentences if needed. Never source figures from unrelated recommendations, navigation, advertisements or snippets, and never invent missing numbers.
Run at most two Firecrawl searches concurrently. On HTTP 429, respect Retry-After or wait 60 seconds, retry once, then log Retry status. A rate-limit failure is not a zero-result search.

Log every returned URL, exact query, rank, discovery status, date evidence, reason, duplicate linkage, and retrieval failure through POST /api/backfill. Snippets alone remain Awaiting retrieval, not article records.
Prioritize existing Awaiting retrieval and Retry items, not only fresh discoveries. Resolve or retry readable 2026 candidates before leaving them indefinitely in the log.

For capped jobs, POST new narrower jobs to /api/backfill with id, parentId, sourceId, source, month, startDate, endDateExclusive, query, limit and status Queued. Mark the parent Needs narrower search. Check all narrower jobs before suggesting that the original time window has been checked.

Bangla discovery must vary বালু উত্তোলন, বালু তোলা, বালু লুট, সিলিকা বালু, পাথর উত্তোলন, পাথর লুট and কোয়ারি. English discovery must vary sand extraction, sand mining, sand lifting, gravel extraction and stone quarrying. Search result limits and indexing make all checks partial.

If using Firecrawl JSON extraction, use jsonOptions.prompt without a schema object because the current connector rejects schema fields. Verify extracted dates against actual publication labels or publisher metadata.

Use the publication calendar shown by each source. Bangladesh sources may already be on the next day in Asia/Dhaka while the user is in America/Chicago. Do not mistake a source header clock for an article date.
Continue through the current date; refresh the current-month end boundary and enqueue source-month jobs for newly begun months. Preserve completed historical jobs and their exact original queries.

Previously logged Outside date scope items can now be reconsidered for historical inclusion. Preserve their original retrieval evidence and link successful imports; do not rewrite an old search as newly performed. Source-year checks are partial keyword checks, not complete coverage.
execution: Read the current Site with Sites get_site. Require owner-private access: owner is the only allowed user and there are no allowed groups or external visitors. Stop if the audience changed.
Retrieve /api/update-plan and /api/archive using a fresh Sites service access token in the OAI-Sites-Authorization header. Keep credentials in memory and hidden stdin only.

GET /api/backfill for pending jobs and read discovery backlog from /api/archive. Perform bounded searches and scrapes. POST exact searches and all returned hits to /api/backfill, plus job status updates. Preserve failures and capped-result searches.
POST one JSON object to /api/ingest with runId, records, sourceChecks, found, queries, and errors. Use a stable runId for retries. Never republish the Site for routine collection.
GET /api/archive again and confirm inserted IDs, Pending status, and saved run. Report only meaningful additions or failures.
historicalCoverage: All available reports from the territory of Bangladesh, including pre-2026 material and 2026. Search indexing and source availability limit coverage.
